LSE 0.5.1 fixes the three problems that stopped long prompts on the iPad. Qwen3.8-27B Q4 with its Q8 DFlash2 draft now runs a full agent turn on an iPad Pro (M4) with an R9700: **68.9 tok/s** decode at 94% draft acceptance, 20.5 GiB peak device memory.

## Fixes

1. **loomc no longer asks for 16 GiB when compiling prefill kernels.** Four loom passes doubled an array on every append instead of when full; iPadOS refused the request. Compiles now peak around 150 MiB.
2. **Host copies of weights are released after upload.** A loaded engine kept 3.0 GiB of host mirrors; it now keeps about 150 MiB, and loading ends with a "releasing" phase.
3. **No device-path fallback.** A group the GPU can't run fails the request with the exact cause instead of re-running per node in fresh buffers. CPU fallback stays, is reported in `lse_warnings`, and `--no-cpu-fallback` turns it off.

## Also in this release

- KV sessions per `session_id`, released on close (`lse_session_close`, `DELETE /v1/lse/sessions/{id}`).
- `lse_close` returns all device memory, so an app can reload in process.
- Device memory and host memory reported by purpose in `lse_status`.
- Device power awareness: `lse_power_prepare`/`lse_power_resume`, retryable errors while suspended.

## Downloads

| Asset | For |
| --- | --- |
| `lse-v0.5.1-macos-arm64.tar.gz` | macOS 15+ on Apple Silicon with an external AMD GPU and the [mac_linuxgpu](https://github.com/lemonade-sdk/mac_linuxgpu) driver |
| `lse-v0.5.1-ios-arm64.xcframework.zip` | iOS/iPadOS 26+ apps that embed the mac_linuxgpu driver; contains `LSE.xcframework` |
| `lse-v0.5.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Linux x86_64 with ROCm 7.x |

Each asset has a `.sha256` beside it. The C ABI version is unchanged (`LSE_ABI_VERSION` 1).
